moves.name: David Montgomery
moves.text: Drop candidate: David Montgomery (HOU RB) - ESPN: "week-to-week" (Oct 12); out Weeks 6-8, back about Week 9 (Week 8 is his bye); ~10.7 a game when healthy. No IR slot is left, so holding him costs a roster seat while he is out. The cheapest other bench seat to free instead: Aaron Rodgers (PIT QB), worth ~4 pts to the best lineup through Week 17. Dom's call - never an order.
